practice_units.title: Preamble Keywords
practice_units.problem: Explain what the words 'Sovereign' and 'Secular' mean in the Preamble.
guidance: Sovereign means the country is independent and not controlled by any outside power.
Secular means the government does not favor any one religion and treats all equally.
practice_units.solution: Sovereign: Independent decision-making power. Secular: Equality of all religions and state neutrality.
